title: 一座城究竟是怎样被攻下的？
title_en: How Is a Holding Actually Captured?

chapters.title: 一座城，究竟在哪一刻被拿下？
chapters.title_en: When is this holding actually captured?

utterances.zh: 五千多名围攻者，对着四百多名守军，为什么还要等上几个月？增援、破墙、强攻，究竟哪一步把这座城拿下来？
utterances.en: Over 5,000 besiegers face just over 400 defenders. Why wait months? Which matters: reinforcements, a breach, or an assault?
facts: 1067年1月10日首次记录自军Siege6/刘易斯省1506：B5660 G420 fort3 C2.46 T305.434 N124；不是内部建立tick。
4月22省1506 occupiedtrue/occupier33388、siegeobservabletrue/active_siegenull、G25；通知围攻获胜/现在控制南撒克逊/9gold。typedArmy0=6384。Jan10首次记录→Apr22相隔102日，非完整内部工期。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 今天只追一座城：军队怎样开始围城，怎样推进，什么时候重新选择，最后又怎样拿下这座据点。
utterances.en: Today follow one holding: how its siege starts, how it progresses, when choices change, and how the holding is eventually captured.
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 这次从一零六六年的威廉开局出发，正在打诺曼人征服英格兰。我们跟着他的军队，围到南撒克逊的刘易斯城破。
utterances.en: Start as William in 1066, during the Norman conquest of England. Follow his army through the siege and capture of Lewes in Sussex.
facts: 1067年1月10日首次记录自军Siege6/刘易斯省1506：B5660 G420 fort3 C2.46 T305.434 N124；不是内部建立tick。
同War1原生norman_conquest_cb，Apr19四项0，Apr22战斗0囚犯0占领13计时0 total13/victoryfalse；before距城破3日，未隔离所有同期他城变化。 本场UI占领tooltip县项南撒克逊+13.2%，原生整分项13；这不是统一每城面值或所有战争通用cap。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 这一期使用一点二零点零点三的原版规则。城防、守军、推进速度与事件，各自影响不同的步骤，不能只盯住一个百分比。
utterances.en: This episode uses vanilla 1.20.0.3 rules. Fort level, garrison, progress speed and events affect different steps; one percentage is not the whole picture.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 先问三个最实用的问题：现在能不能推进？每天推进多少？下一次事件，又会把哪一项输入改掉？
utterances.en: Start with three practical questions: can progress continue, how much is gained each day, and which input might the next event change?
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 围城窗里的剩余天数，是用当前状态算出的估计。守军变了、速度变了，或者事件带来额外进度，这个答案也会变。
utterances.en: The remaining days are estimated from the current state. A changed garrison, changed speed or extra event progress can change that answer.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 前两期讲过战争与战斗。今天只借用这一点背景：打赢一场战斗，和把一座城占下来，是战争里两种不同的进展。
utterances.en: Earlier episodes covered war and battles. Keep one distinction: winning a battle and occupying a holding advance a war in different ways.
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

chapters.title: 军队到了，围城就开始了吗？
chapters.title_en: Does arrival mean the siege has started?

utterances.zh: 军队从诺曼底渡海，接近英格兰南岸。主力先上岸，后来招募的射石机还在另一支增援里，没有提前帮城外的军队做工作。
utterances.en: The army crosses from Normandy to England. The main force lands first; the newly recruited mangonels remain with a separate reinforcement force.
facts: 本案射石机招募tooltip：一档10、+.3/天、有效最大城防10；初始5/10；gold728→668.6净59.4。原有60围攻兵不是新购团。
1067年1月10日首次记录自军Siege6/刘易斯省1506：B5660 G420 fort3 C2.46 T305.434 N124；不是内部建立tick。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 到一零六七年一月十日，我们第一次记录到这场自军围城。城里四百二十名守军，城外五千六百六十名合格围攻者。
utterances.en: On 10 January 1067, our first recorded own-army siege has 420 defenders and 5,660 eligible besiegers.
facts: 1067年1月10日首次记录自军Siege6/刘易斯省1506：B5660 G420 fort3 C2.46 T305.434 N124；不是内部建立tick。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 军队的总人数，和真正能参加围城的人数，并不总是一回事。判断兵力够不够，要看当前能围城的那一部分。
utterances.en: Total army strength is not always the same as the strength eligible to besiege. Use the troops that can actually take part.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 能参加围城的兵力如果少于当前守军，围城就会受阻。先满足这道人数条件，才有后面的进度可谈。
utterances.en: Eligible besieging strength below the current garrison blocks progress. Meet that strength requirement before counting progress.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 这道比较用的是“少于”，不是“少于或等于”。人数刚好相等时，再看窗口有没有其他受阻原因。
utterances.en: This particular check is below, rather than below or equal. At equal strength, check the window for other blockers.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 军队移动或进入战斗，也可能打断围城。进度停住时，先看围城窗里的说明，再决定增兵、停下，还是处理敌军。
utterances.en: Movement or battle can also interrupt a siege. Read the blocker before choosing to reinforce, halt or deal with the enemy army.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 这里人数足够，围城也确实在推进。军队只停在附近、敌军正在围别的城，都不能替代眼前这支军队自己的围城。
utterances.en: Here the manpower check is satisfied and work is advancing. An army nearby, or an enemy siege elsewhere, does not establish our own siege.
facts: 1067年1月10日首次记录自军Siege6/刘易斯省1506：B5660 G420 fort3 C2.46 T305.434 N124；不是内部建立tick。
1月10→11实际24小时，同Siege6 C2.46→4.92净2.46，B/G/T未变，N124→123；UI显示2.4。不独立发布普通D或完整phase账本。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 先别急着盯剩余天数。把城防、守军和当前进度看清楚，才知道我们到底要完成多少工作。
utterances.en: Before focusing on remaining days, read the fort, garrison and progress. They explain how much work remains.
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 刘易斯的城防是三级，起初守军四百二十。这个城防数字，一方面影响总工作量，另一方面还会检查攻城器械的等级。
utterances.en: Lewes has fort level 3 and initially 420 defenders. Fort level affects both total work and the equipment checks used for siege speed.
facts: 1067年1月10日首次记录自军Siege6/刘易斯省1506：B5660 G420 fort3 C2.46 T305.434 N124；不是内部建立tick。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 进度背后有两项工作量：已经累积多少，以及按当前城里状态，总共需要多少。两者的比例，才成为进度条。
utterances.en: Progress compares two quantities: accumulated work and the total required by the holding's current state. Their ratio drives the progress fraction.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 用一个规则算例看：总共需要四百点工作，已经完成二百点，进度就是百分之五十。
utterances.en: For a labelled example, 200 work completed out of a required 400 gives fifty percent progress.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 总工作量从一百开始，再加入城防与守军比例形成的部分。城防的每一级，在这条规则里对应七十五点工作。
utterances.en: Total work starts at 100, then adds a term based on fort level and the garrison ratio. Each fort level contributes 75 work before that ratio is applied.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 守军比例，用当前守军除以有效上限，最多按满员来算。城里越接近满员，城防增加的工作量就越完整。
utterances.en: The garrison ratio is current strength divided by its effective maximum, capped at full. A fuller garrison gives the fort term more weight.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 仍用静态算例：城防四级，守军比例为一。一百加四乘七十五，得到四百点总工作量。
utterances.en: For another static example, fort level four with a full garrison ratio requires 100 plus four times 75: a total of 400 work.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 城防仍是四级，守军比例改成一半，额外部分也乘一半。于是总工作量变成二百五十，而不是仍锁在四百。
utterances.en: Keep fort level four, but use a half-full garrison ratio. Halve the extra term and total work becomes 250, rather than remaining fixed at 400.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 这份总量会跟着守军状态变化。围城开始时需要四百点，并不代表后面每天都还需要同样四百点。
utterances.en: The requirement changes with the garrison. A starting total of 400 need not remain 400 throughout the siege.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 这也提醒我们：进度条变快，未必全是每天做得更多。需要完成的总量发生变化，同样会改变这个比例。
utterances.en: A faster-looking progress bar need not mean more work per day. A changed required total can also change the fraction.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 一月十日，已做二点四六，总量约三百零五点四三。进度还不到百分之一；人数占优，并不等于城墙已经快要失守。
utterances.en: On 10 January, work is 2.46 out of about 305.43, less than one percent. A manpower advantage does not mean the walls are nearly lost.
facts: 1067年1月10日首次记录自军Siege6/刘易斯省1506：B5660 G420 fort3 C2.46 T305.434 N124；不是内部建立tick。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 可就在三天后，守军从四百二十补到四百六十，总工作量随之来到三百二十五。城外没换目标，城里要完成的量已经变了。
utterances.en: Three days later, defenders rise from 420 to 460 and total work reaches 325. The target has not changed, but the work required has.
utterances.visual_note: Exact actual source pins in live-source facts; static example labeled separately.

utterances.zh: 这一天工作仍增加二点四六，剩余天数却从一百二十二变成一百二十九。倒计时变长，并不等于你的军队白围了一天。
utterances.en: Work still gains 2.46 that day, yet the estimate rises from 122 to 129 days. A longer countdown does not mean the army wasted a day.
utterances.visual_note: Exact actual source pins in live-source facts; static example labeled separately.

utterances.zh: 所以看到剩余天数往回跳，先比较守军和总量。若只凭进度条猜成敌军突然获得神秘加速，就会选错自己的应对办法。
utterances.en: When the countdown jumps, compare the garrison and total work first. The progress bar alone cannot tell you which input changed.
utterances.visual_note: Exact actual source pins in live-source facts; static example labeled separately.

utterances.zh: 城外的兵力，决定普通兵力加成。攻城器械又提供另一份贡献；所以给围城增兵，也要看增来的是什么。
utterances.en: Outside strength supplies one bonus, while siege engines add another. Reinforcing a siege also means checking what kinds of troops arrive.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 开围时，窗口列出六十名围攻士兵。这是原有部队的合计，不能把这六十名全部当成刚买的那一团射石机。
utterances.en: At the opening, the UI lists 60 siege soldiers from the existing force. These are not all members of the newly purchased mangonel regiment.
facts: 1067年1月10日首次记录自军Siege6/刘易斯省1506：B5660 G420 fort3 C2.46 T305.434 N124；不是内部建立tick。
本案射石机招募tooltip：一档10、+.3/天、有效最大城防10；初始5/10；gold728→668.6净59.4。原有60围攻兵不是新购团。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 新团的招募提示是射石机：每天加零点三，有效最大城防十级。推进数值和能覆盖的城防范围，是两项不同的属性。
utterances.en: The new mangonel tooltip shows +0.3 per day and effectiveness through fort level 10. Speed contribution and fort coverage are separate attributes.
facts: 本案射石机招募tooltip：一档10、+.3/天、有效最大城防10；初始5/10；gold728→668.6净59.4。原有60围攻兵不是新购团。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.
utterances.condition: Current-case army actually has the referenced siege engine; otherwise remove or rewrite before freeze.

utterances.zh: 这团满一档是十，刚建立时只有五，之后才补员。它还要完成行军、加入围攻，纸面编制才会变成城外实际有用的规模。
utterances.en: One full stack is 10, but the new regiment starts at 5 and reinforces later. It must also arrive and participate before helping this siege.
facts: 本案射石机招募tooltip：一档10、+.3/天、有效最大城防10；初始5/10；gold728→668.6净59.4。原有60围攻兵不是新购团。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.
utterances.condition: Current-case army actually has the referenced siege engine; otherwise remove or rewrite before freeze.

utterances.zh: 这次招募前金币七百二十八，之后六百六十八点六，差五十九点四。买下来是准备，真正抵达才是围城里的下一步。
utterances.en: Gold changes from 728 to 668.6, a difference of 59.4. Recruitment prepares the force; arrival is the next step for the siege.
facts: 本案射石机招募tooltip：一档10、+.3/天、有效最大城防10；初始5/10；gold728→668.6净59.4。原有60围攻兵不是新购团。
utterances.visual_note: Exact actual source pins in live-source facts; static example labeled separately.

utterances.zh: 器械贡献按当前数量除以每档编制，再乘有效攻城数值，逐团加起来。半档和满档不同，不能把原始人数直接乘上兵种面板数值。
utterances.en: For each eligible regiment, multiply its effective siege value by current count divided by stack size. Half a stack is not a full stack.
facts: 逐团effective siege_value乘归一化current count/stack，不是原始人数乘stock。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 比如一档十、当前五，就按半档规模；当前十才是一档。这里解释计算方式，不用早期合计六十反猜每一团的型号。
utterances.en: For a stack of 10, current count 5 means half a stack; 10 means one full stack. This explains the rule without identifying every early regiment.
facts: 本案射石机招募tooltip：一档10、+.3/天、有效最大城防10；初始5/10；gold728→668.6净59.4。原有60围攻兵不是新购团。
utterances.visual_note: Exact actual source pins in live-source facts; static example labeled separately.

utterances.zh: 攻城数值和有效城防范围，要分开看。一个帮助每天推进，另一个告诉我们：面对更高城防，器械会不会跟不上。
utterances.en: Read siege value and effective fort range separately. One helps daily progress; the other warns when the engines fall behind stronger walls.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 城防超出器械有效范围以后，也不是整支军队自动停止围城。要看跨了哪道门槛，再判断对应的速度惩罚。
utterances.en: When fort level exceeds the equipment's effective range, the whole siege does not automatically stop. Check the thresholds crossed and their speed penalties.
facts: 静态规则或明确条件算例，非未观测的本案结果。
utterances.visual_note: Exact actual source pins in live-source facts; static example labeled separately.

utterances.zh: 城里的工作量、城外的军队都看过了。现在让日历走一天，看这支军队究竟能推进多少。
utterances.en: The required work and army are laid out. Let one day pass to see how much this army can advance.
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 初期窗口的每天进度显示二点四，说明里还列着基础、兵力与围攻士兵。稍后实际一天的工作差值，会比这一位小数更细。
utterances.en: The opening UI shows 2.4 work per day, with base, manpower and siege-soldier terms. Our observed daily work difference has greater precision.
facts: 1月10→11实际24小时，同Siege6 C2.46→4.92净2.46，B/G/T未变，N124→123；UI显示2.4。不独立发布普通D或完整phase账本。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

chapters.title: 等待怎样变成下一次变化？
chapters.title_en: How does waiting produce the next change?

utterances.zh: 普通围城的基础日速是一。之后叠加器械、兵力和其他修正，再经过城防影响，最后检查最低日速。
utterances.en: Ordinary siege speed starts at one. Engine and strength contributions and other modifiers are applied, followed by fort effects and the final minimum speed.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 多出的合格围城兵力，是围攻兵力减去守军，负数按零处理。每满二百人，增加零点零一点工作速度。
utterances.en: Excess eligible strength is besieging strength minus the garrison, floored at zero. Every complete group of 200 adds 0.01 to daily work speed.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 算例里，围攻二千五百、守军五百，多出二千。二千除二百是十组，因此这一项加零点一。
utterances.en: In a labelled example, 2,500 besiegers against 500 garrison leave 2,000 excess. That makes ten groups of 200 and adds 0.1.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 多出一百九十九人，还没有凑成一组；到二百人才拿到这零点零一。多塞一点兵，不一定马上改变这一项加成。
utterances.en: An excess of 199 completes no group; 200 earns the 0.01. A small reinforcement need not immediately change this particular bonus.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 城防还有第二个作用：检查当前器械能覆盖哪些门槛。达到一道器械无法覆盖的门槛，推进速度就会多受一层惩罚。
utterances.en: Fort level also checks which thresholds the current engines cover. Reaching an uncovered threshold adds another speed penalty.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 这一版的城防门槛是四、六、十一、十六、三十一。达到门槛就开始检查，不必再高出一级才生效。
utterances.en: This build’s fort thresholds are four, six, eleven, sixteen and thirty-one. The check starts at the threshold, without requiring another fort level.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 每遇到一道器械等级无法覆盖的城防门槛，速度就乘零点七。两道都无法覆盖，就把零点七乘两次。
utterances.en: For each reached fort threshold that the siege tier cannot cover, multiply speed by 0.7. Two uncovered thresholds mean two multiplications.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 规则算例里，城防四级，已经达到第一道门槛。没有合格器械等级覆盖它，速度就乘零点七。
utterances.en: In a rule example, fort level four reaches the first threshold. Without an eligible siege tier to cover it, speed is multiplied by 0.7.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 城防六级，已经达到四和六这两道门槛。两道都无法覆盖时，零点七乘零点七，得到零点四九。
utterances.en: Fort level six reaches the thresholds at four and six. If neither is covered, multiplying 0.7 twice gives 0.49.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 若最高合格攻城等级是一，覆盖第一道门槛，六级城防还剩第二道要受罚。此时速度只乘一次零点七。
utterances.en: With highest eligible siege tier one, the first threshold is covered. Fort level six leaves the second uncovered, applying 0.7 once.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 因而同样一支军队，面对更高城防，不只是要做更多工作；如果器械等级追不上，每天做得也可能更少。
utterances.en: A higher fort can require more work from the same army and, if engine tier falls behind, reduce the work it can accomplish each day.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 本案城防三级，还没到第一道四级门槛。我们能用这座城看增援和事件，但不会假装在这里实测过十一或十六级城防。
utterances.en: This holding has fort level 3, below the first threshold at 4. It illustrates reinforcement and events, not a live test of level 11 or 16 forts.
facts: 1067年1月10日首次记录自军Siege6/刘易斯省1506：B5660 G420 fort3 C2.46 T305.434 N124；不是内部建立tick。
utterances.visual_note: Exact actual source pins in live-source facts; static example labeled separately.

utterances.zh: 最后还有最低日速零点五。修正之后只算出零点三七，也会按零点五推进；这是最终的保底值。
utterances.en: The final minimum is 0.5. A calculated 0.37 is raised to 0.5; this floor applies at the end.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 剩余天数再从剩余工作量算。规则算例里，总量四百、已做二百，还剩二百；当前日速二，预计需要一百天。
utterances.en: Remaining days use remaining work. In an example with total 400, completed 200 and current speed two, the remaining 200 work gives an estimate of 100 days.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 用一个明确算例：预计一百点二天，还需要一百零一天。把最后剩下的那一点工作也完成，才到终点。
utterances.en: For a clear example, an estimate of 100.2 days rounds up to 101 days. The final fraction of work still needs completing.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 从一月十日到十一日，日历走了整整一天。两端围攻兵力五千六百六十、守军四百二十，总工作量也没有改变。
utterances.en: From 10 to 11 January, exactly one day passes. Both endpoints show 5,660 besiegers, 420 defenders and the same total work.
facts: 1月10→11实际24小时，同Siege6 C2.46→4.92净2.46，B/G/T未变，N124→123；UI显示2.4。不独立发布普通D或完整phase账本。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 工作从二点四六增加到四点九二，实测净增二点四六。这里讲的是这一日的前后差值，不把所有可能的事件都凭空排除。
utterances.en: Work rises from 2.46 to 4.92: a net gain of 2.46 over this day. This is an observed difference, without claiming every possible event is excluded.
facts: 1月10→11实际24小时，同Siege6 C2.46→4.92净2.46，B/G/T未变，N124→123；UI显示2.4。不独立发布普通D或完整phase账本。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 界面显示二点四，这一日实际净增二点四六；剩余估计从一百二十四到一百二十三天。比较时，要分清显示精度和实际变化。
utterances.en: The UI shows 2.4, while this day gains 2.46. The estimate falls from 124 to 123 days. Distinguish display precision from observed change.
facts: 1月10→11实际24小时，同Siege6 C2.46→4.92净2.46，B/G/T未变，N124→123；UI显示2.4。不独立发布普通D或完整phase账本。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 判断增援有没有帮助，也可以用同样办法：先记下来之前的状态，过一个真实相邻日，再比较工作，别只看人头刚刚变大。
utterances.en: Use the same approach for reinforcement: record the initial state, compare a real adjacent day, then inspect work rather than the new headcount alone.
facts: 1月10→11实际24小时，同Siege6 C2.46→4.92净2.46，B/G/T未变，N124→123；UI显示2.4。不独立发布普通D或完整phase账本。
utterances.visual_note: Exact actual source pins in live-source facts; static example labeled separately.

utterances.zh: 刚才追的是普通的一天。接下来看看事件：有的改变等待间隔，有的送来一笔工作，还有的改掉后续速度。
utterances.en: That was an ordinary day. Events can instead change the waiting interval, add a lump of work, or alter subsequent speed.
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

chapters.title: 下一次结算改变了什么？
chapters.title_en: What changes at the next resolution?

utterances.zh: 普通日进度先加入。如果工作已经够了，围城就完成；否则阶段到期后，事件再按自己的类型结算，并非每种都送一笔工作。
utterances.en: Ordinary daily work is added first. If enough work is done, the siege completes; otherwise a due phase resolves its event according to type.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 阶段间隔的基础值是二十天，相关修正和破口会改变实际间隔。还没到下次事件时，普通进度仍然每天累积。
utterances.en: Phase length starts at twenty days; modifiers and a breach change the actual interval. Ordinary work still accumulates before the next event.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 日常工作与事件变化可以同时存在。看见进度一次跳了很多，先查事件和总量，不要直接宣布日速突然翻倍。
utterances.en: Daily work and event changes can coexist. A large jump calls for checking events and required work before concluding that daily speed doubled.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 一月二十七日，我们首次记录到一级破口。前一天墙还没有缺口；现在，城墙状态已经给玩家打开了新的选择。
utterances.en: On 27 January, our records first show a level-one breach. The previous day had none. The changed walls now open another choice.
facts: 1月26→27 breach0→1，同Siege6 C43.74→46.52净2.78；1月29C52.08/T325/N99，smallbreach tooltip -10%，currentphase显示16天，来源未完整归因。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 破口、断粮、疾病、守军逃亡，还有僵持，效果各不相同。先看发生了哪一种，再看它改变工作量、速度，还是等待间隔。
utterances.en: Breach, starvation, disease, desertion and stalemate have different effects. First identify the event, then its effect on work, speed or the next interval.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 先看破口。一、二级破口，对事件间隔分别有负百分之十、负百分之三十的修正。它们不是把城防数字直接扣成零。
utterances.en: First, breaches. Levels one and two modify the event interval by minus ten and minus thirty percent. They do not simply reduce fort level to zero.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 只加入这项修正的算例里，基础二十天，一级对应十八天，二级对应十四天。其他间隔修正还要另外计算。
utterances.en: With only that modifier in a labelled example, twenty days becomes eighteen at breach level one or fourteen at level two. Other interval modifiers still matter.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 再看断粮。第一次升级，另加当时总工作量的百分之五；第二次升级，再另加当时总量的百分之十五，不是把第一次改成十五。
utterances.en: Starvation first adds five percent of the current required work. Its second upgrade adds another fifteen percent of the then-current total; it does not replace the first gain.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 算例里，两次总量都为四百，剩余工作也够，尚未完成围城。第一次加二十，第二次再加六十。
utterances.en: In this example, both totals are 400 and enough work remains to avoid completion. The first adds twenty work, and the second another sixty.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 疾病则改变日速倍率。当前一级加百分之十，当前二级加百分之二十；进入二级时，不再把一级的十叠上去凑三十。
utterances.en: Disease changes the daily-rate multiplier. Current level one adds ten percent, and level two adds twenty; level two does not stack both levels into thirty.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 守军逃亡另加五点围城工作。这里的五是工作量，不是百分之五，也不是界面告诉我们刚好少了五名守军。
utterances.en: Desertion adds five work. That is not five percent, or a claim that the interface shows exactly five fewer defenders.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 抽到哪种事件，要先看当前条件。器械等级、城防和已有事件等级都会改变可选项与权重，不能把基础权重直接念成固定概率。
utterances.en: Event selection depends on current conditions. Engine tier, fort level and existing event levels alter eligibility and weights; base weights are not fixed probabilities.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 破口出现前后，工作从四十三点七四来到四十六点五二，净增二点七八。缺口的作用要看自己的规则，不能把这笔全部叫破墙奖励。
utterances.en: Across the breach transition, work rises from 43.74 to 46.52, a net 2.78. Do not attribute the entire gain to a breach reward.
facts: 1月26→27 breach0→1，同Siege6 C43.74→46.52净2.78；1月29C52.08/T325/N99，smallbreach tooltip -10%，currentphase显示16天，来源未完整归因。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 这两端，守军都是四百六十，围攻兵力六千七百四十六，总工作量三百二十五。破口出现，并没有把这几个数字直接清零。
utterances.en: Both endpoints have 460 defenders, 6,746 besiegers and 325 total work. The breach does not simply erase these values.
facts: 1月26→27 breach0→1，同Siege6 C43.74→46.52净2.78；1月29C52.08/T325/N99，smallbreach tooltip -10%，currentphase显示16天，来源未完整归因。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 一级缺口让强攻成为可用选项。但“可以强攻”与“应该强攻”，是两个判断；先把眼前的收益和兵员风险摆出来。
utterances.en: The level-one breach makes assault available. Whether it is allowed and whether it is worthwhile are separate decisions.
facts: 1月26→27 breach0→1，同Siege6 C43.74→46.52净2.78；1月29C52.08/T325/N99，smallbreach tooltip -10%，currentphase显示16天，来源未完整归因。
1月29有合法一级破口：开始回读flag true，日预览13.6work/168人；1月29→30同Siege6 C52.08→68.46净16.38，有效参围B6746→6578净-168；不隔离纯强攻贡献或逐团死亡。次预览13.2/164。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 到一月二十九日，工作五十二点零八，总量三百二十五，预计还剩九十九天。窗口这时显示当前阶段十六天。
utterances.en: By 29 January, work is 52.08 of 325 and the estimate is 99 days. The UI shows 16 days for the current phase.
facts: 1月26→27 breach0→1，同Siege6 C43.74→46.52净2.78；1月29C52.08/T325/N99，smallbreach tooltip -10%，currentphase显示16天，来源未完整归因。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 这十六天是窗口显示的当前阶段时间，不是从现在还要等十六天。破口确有负百分之十修正，其他间隔因素还要另看。
utterances.en: The 16 days describe the displayed current phase, not necessarily 16 days remaining. The breach has a minus-ten-percent modifier; other factors remain separate.
facts: 1月26→27 breach0→1，同Siege6 C43.74→46.52净2.78；1月29C52.08/T325/N99，smallbreach tooltip -10%，currentphase显示16天，来源未完整归因。
utterances.visual_note: Exact actual source pins in live-source facts; static example labeled separately.

chapters.title: 现在还能沿用刚才的估计吗？
chapters.title_en: Can the previous estimate still be used?

utterances.zh: 没有合格攻城等级时，这条抽取不会给破口权重。想等破口、再考虑强攻，先查器械条件，别把等待当成必然破墙。
utterances.en: Without an eligible siege tier, this draw gives breach zero weight. Check the engines before relying on a breach and assault; waiting alone does not guarantee one.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 抽到“僵持”，则没有这笔额外事件工作。不过当天普通日进度已经照常加入，不能把僵持说成整天完全没有推进。
utterances.en: Stalemate adds no extra event work. Ordinary daily progress has already been added, so it does not mean an entire day without progress.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 破口、断粮和疾病到最高二级后，会从后续抽取中排除。可选项变了，同一组基础权重自然也不是永远相同的机会。
utterances.en: Breach, starvation and disease are excluded from later draws at their maximum level of two. A changed eligible set changes the chances represented by the base weights.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 在比较强攻之前，倒回来看增援。它不是在购买按钮按下时就生效，也不能把抵达后的速度套回整个渡海过程。
utterances.en: Before comparing assault, return to reinforcements. Recruitment does not instantly help a siege, and post-arrival speed cannot describe the whole crossing.
facts: 本案射石机招募tooltip：一档10、+.3/天、有效最大城防10；初始5/10；gold728→668.6净59.4。原有60围攻兵不是新购团。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 一月二十日，参围兵力来到六千七百四十六，前一日还是五千六百六十。接下来再看相邻两天，实际工作增量怎样变化。
utterances.en: On 20 January, eligible strength reaches 6,746, up from 5,660 the day before. Now compare the work gains across adjacent days.
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 抵达的那个相邻日，工作二十四点六到二十七点零六，仍净增二点四六。不能把日末出现的新兵，当成这一整天都已参围。
utterances.en: Across the arrival day, work goes from 24.6 to 27.06, still a net 2.46. Troops present at the endpoint were not necessarily there all day.
utterances.visual_note: Exact actual source pins in live-source facts; static example labeled separately.

utterances.zh: 再过一天，二十七点零六到二十九点八四，净增二点七八。窗口后来列出六十九名围攻士兵，每天进度显示二点七。
utterances.en: The next day gains 2.78, from 27.06 to 29.84. The later UI lists 69 siege soldiers and displays 2.7 work per day.
utterances.visual_note: Exact actual source pins in live-source facts; static example labeled separately.

utterances.zh: 正常合军之后，再过一天，工作二十九点八四到三十二点六二，也净增二点七八。这不是合军按钮凭空奖励的一笔进度。

utterances.zh: 如果墙已有缺口，这时玩家会遇到另一种选择：继续等，还是付出兵员风险强攻？先看按钮当前允许什么。
utterances.en: If the walls have a breach, another choice appears: keep waiting or risk soldiers in an assault. Start with what the button currently permits.

utterances.zh: 强攻至少要有破口，围攻兵力也不能低于守军。围城受阻时，即使墙上有缺口，也不能直接开始强攻。
utterances.en: Assault requires a breach, with eligible besiegers not below the garrison. A blocked siege cannot simply assault through an existing breach.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果

utterances.zh: 一月二十九日，一级破口、六千七百四十六名围攻者，强攻确实可用。我们短试一天，再决定要不要继续付出兵员。
utterances.en: On 29 January, a level-one breach and 6,746 eligible besiegers allow assault. We try one day before deciding whether to keep spending manpower.

utterances.zh: 当时预览是每天额外十三点六工作、预计一百六十八人减员。十三点六是工作量，不是进度条直接加十三点六个百分点。

utterances.en: The preview changes with current troops and garrison. It helps compare the present choices, rather than guaranteeing final losses.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果

utterances.zh: 这次实际开启强攻，围城状态也已经变成强攻中。我们从一月二十九日推进到三十日，前后仍是同一场围城。
utterances.en: We start the assault and confirm its active state. Advance from 29 to 30 January, staying with the same siege.
facts: 1月29有合法一级破口：开始回读flag true，日预览13.6work/168人；1月29→30同Siege6 C52.08→68.46净16.38，有效参围B6746→6578净-168；不隔离纯强攻贡献或逐团死亡。次预览13.2/164。

utterances.zh: 这一日，工作从五十二点零八到六十八点四六，净增十六点三八。参围兵力从六千七百四十六变为六千五百七十八。

utterances.zh: 于是我们停止强攻，确认它已经关闭；工作仍是六十八点四六。剩余估计回到九十三天，后面继续正常围城。
utterances.en: We stop the assault and confirm it is off. Work remains 68.46, the estimate returns to 93 days, and ordinary siege resumes.

utterances.zh: 无论继续等还是强攻，眼前的目标都没变：把这座城拿下来。接下来，进入围城的最后一段。
utterances.en: Whether waiting or assaulting, the objective remains capture. Enter the final stretch of this siege.

utterances.zh: 一直推进到四月十五日，画面已是大破口，说明写着阶段时间负百分之三十，最新事件是僵持。我们没有拍到每一种随机结果。
utterances.en: By 15 April, the UI shows a large breach with minus-thirty-percent phase time and the latest result is a stalemate. This run does not show every random outcome.
facts: 4月15真实UI显示最新僵持、大破口(-30%)、G484/B6384/日速2.7；不是本场全事件账本。

utterances.zh: 这时守军四百八十四，围攻兵力六千三百八十四，每天进度显示二点七。后面的估计，继续按这些当前状态重新看。
utterances.en: Now the UI shows 484 defenders, 6,384 besiegers and 2.7 work per day. Read the later estimate against these current conditions.
facts: 4月15真实UI显示最新僵持、大破口(-30%)、G484/B6384/日速2.7；不是本场全事件账本。

utterances.zh: 到四月二十一日，城仍没有落入我们手里。工作已做三百二十三点六三，总量三百二十五，还差一点三七。
utterances.en: On 21 April, the holding is still unoccupied by us. Work is 323.63 of 325, leaving 1.37.

utterances.zh: 四月十九日到二十二日，最后三次记录各走一天。二十日还差四点一三，二十一日还差一点三七，下一日才真正占下来。
utterances.en: The last three recorded advances each cover one day, from 19 to 22 April. Work remaining is 4.13 on the 20th and 1.37 on the 21st; capture follows next day.

chapters.title: 一直看到城破
chapters.title_en: Follow the siege through actual capture

utterances.zh: 四月二十二日，刘易斯围城结束。画面出现围攻获胜的通知，南撒克逊铺上蓝色占领斜线；这次终于从推进变成控制。
utterances.en: On 22 April, the siege of Lewes ends. The victory notice appears and blue occupation stripes cover Sussex: progress has become control.
facts: 4月22省1506 occupiedtrue/occupier33388、siegeobservabletrue/active_siegenull、G25；通知围攻获胜/现在控制南撒克逊/9gold。typedArmy0=6384。Jan10首次记录→Apr22相隔102日，非完整内部工期。

utterances.zh: 同一个据点，现在已经被占领，原来的围城也不再存在。军队仍在这里；当前主力人数读到六千三百八十四。
utterances.en: The same objective is now occupied and the previous siege is gone. The army remains here, with the main force currently at 6,384 soldiers.

utterances.zh: 占领者是我们扮演的威廉。城里的守军读到二十五，但不能只拿守军变少来证明城破；占领与围城后态要一起看。
utterances.en: William is the occupier, and the garrison now reads 25. A smaller garrison alone does not prove capture; occupation and siege state must agree.
facts: 4月22省1506 occupiedtrue/occupier33388、siegeobservabletrue/active_siegenull、G25；通知围攻获胜/现在控制南撒克逊/9gold。typedArmy0=6384。Jan10首次记录→Apr22相隔102日，非完整内部工期。

utterances.zh: 占领先告诉我们，城现在由谁控制。领地法律上归谁，是另一项状态；若要说归属改变，还得看拥有者是否真的换了。
utterances.en: Occupation tells us who controls the holding now. Legal ownership is a separate state; an ownership change needs the actual owner to change.

utterances.zh: 南撒克逊面板列着伯爵领持有者利奥夫温，同时显示我们占领。军事控制和领地的法律归属，是两份不同的状态。
utterances.en: The Sussex panel lists Leofwine as county holder while showing our occupation. Military control and legal ownership are separate states.
facts: 4月22县UI南撒克逊伯国持有者利奥夫温，占领者你；Hastings城市也显示玩家占领。这是当前county状态，不冒称b_lewes法律拥有者围前/后配对。

utterances.zh: 占领分也不是每座城一张固定面值的奖券。它要看原版统计的合格领地范围、占领比例，以及这场战争理由的规则。
utterances.en: Occupation score is not a fixed-value ticket for each holding. It depends on the native eligible territory set, occupied share and this war's casus belli rules.

utterances.zh: 战争理由不同，占领的计分规则也会不同；首都还可能有额外影响。所以一座城加多少分，要放回这场战争里看。
utterances.en: Different casus belli can use different occupation rules, and a capital can add an extra effect. Interpret a holding’s score within its own war.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果

utterances.en: Second, separate required work from speed. Forts can raise the requirement and penalize speed through missing engine tiers; more troops do not automatically erase those effects.
